verses.ar: تَرْنِيمَةُ ٱلْمَصَاعِدِ. لِدَاوُدَ «لَوْلَا ٱلرَّبُّ ٱلَّذِي كَانَ لَنَا». لِيَقُلْ إِسْرَائِيلُ:
verses.kjv: A Song of degrees of David. If [it had not been] the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;
verses.web: A Song of Ascents. By David. If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, let Israel now say,

verses.ar: «لَوْلَا ٱلرَّبُّ ٱلَّذِي كَانَ لَنَا عِنْدَ مَا قَامَ ٱلنَّاسُ عَلَيْنَا،
verses.kjv: If [it had not been] the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
verses.web: if it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, when men rose up against us,

verses.ar: إِذًا لَٱبْتَلَعُونَا أَحْيَاءً عِنْدَ ٱحْتِمَاءِ غَضَبِهِمْ عَلَيْنَا،
verses.kjv: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
verses.web: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,

verses.ar: إِذًا لَجَرَفَتْنَا ٱلْمِيَاهُ، لَعَبَرَ ٱلسَّيْلُ عَلَى أَنْفُسِنَا.
verses.kjv: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:
verses.web: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.

verses.ar: إِذًا لَعَبَرَتْ عَلَى أَنْفُسِنَا ٱلْمِيَاهُ ٱلطَّامِيَةُ».
verses.kjv: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
verses.web: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.

verses.ar: مُبَارَكٌ ٱلرَّبُّ ٱلَّذِي لَمْ يُسْلِمْنَا فَرِيسَةً لِأَسْنَانِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Blessed [be] the LORD, who hath not given us [as] a prey to their teeth.
verses.web: Blessed be Yahweh, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.

verses.ar: ٱنْفَلَتَتْ أَنْفُسُنَا مِثْلَ ٱلْعُصْفُورِ مِنْ فَخِّ ٱلصَّيَّادِينَ. ٱلْفَخُّ ٱنْكَسَرَ، وَنَحْنُ ٱنْفَلَتْنَا.
verses.kjv: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
verses.web: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.

verses.ar: عَوْنُنَا بِٱسْمِ ٱلرَّبِّ، ٱلصَّانِعِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ.
verses.kjv: Our help [is] in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
verses.web: Our help is in Yahweh’s name, who made heaven and earth.
